# ChargeKaro

> Community-powered directory of EV charging stations across India — find, compare and navigate to public and private chargers.

ChargeKaro maps public charging networks (Tata Power, Statiq, ChargeZone, Jio-bp, Zeon, KSEB and more) alongside community-hosted private chargers, with filters for connector type, speed, price and availability.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search chargers, popular cities and live driver updates.
- [Charging stations directory](/stations): Full India-wide station directory with district, provider and connector filters.
- [Explore map](/explore): Interactive map of public and community chargers.
- [Community](/community): Live updates posted by drivers at stations.
- [List your charger](/list): Host form to add a private charger.
- [About](/about): What ChargeKaro is and who it is for.
